newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MONDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed on Monday mixed against hard currencies after a fairly busy interbank session, dealers said.
"There seemed to be quiet a lot of (importer) demand today -- more than we saw last week. Most people were busy trying to square off their positions towards the close of trade," commented one dealer.
He said the local unit finished the day at 11.2950/3050
against the U.S. dollar, weakening from 11.2925/3025 in the morning although this was the same position it closed at on Friday.

Against pound sterling it was quoted at 18.4820/5260 from Friday's 18.5300/5500 and was also firmer versus the mark at 6.5860/6025 compared to 6.6500/6700. It however eased against South Africa's rand to 2.5275/5340 from 2.5200/5400.
